part2.question: Describe a person you know who really likes taking photos

segments.v: I want to talk about my best friend Linh. She likes taking photos very much. I met her in grade 6. She always takes photos with her phone and sometimes she borrows my film camera. She takes photos in many places. She likes to take photos in the Old Quarter on Sunday morning. She takes photos of street sellers, old buildings and people. She also takes photos at school events. Her photos are very beautiful. Many people like her photos on Facebook. I think she is very talented and patient. She can wait a long time to take a good photo. I feel happy to have a friend like her. She helps me see the beauty of the city. I want to learn photography from her.
